messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Alert: sustained error rate spike detected for customer 'Thor Therapeutics' (tenant-thor-42) on dedicated pool 'dedicated-thor-nyc-canary' — 5xx rate 18% over 5m. Paging @oncall-sre.

Aiden H: reading metrics, verified. errors start ~02:11 UTC, correlates with recent canary rollout (artifact: build-2026-04-09-7f3d).

Priya R: confirmed stack traces show OOM-ish noise in runtime allocator around kvcache grow path. stack shows fastpath alloc at attention_kv_put.

Jonah S: tagging customer impact: requests returning 502 for ~35% of canary traffic; dedicated pool is isolated but canary routing still hits tenant. Need to decide: quarantine tenant from canary or roll back pinned artifact.

Maria C: pinging Thor customer success - I told them we're investigating and will follow up within 15m. They reported increased latency and some failures in their admin dashboard.

Aiden H: my recommendation: short-term quarantine the tenant from canary (move traffic to stable pool) and pin back to previous artifact for canary to avoid repeated re-deploys.

Ken L: product note — Thor uses reserved throughput with burst; if we move them off canary we should ensure capacity in stable-dedicated to avoid throttling. Ops ok?

Priya R: I can validate the previous artifact (build-2026-04-02-a9b1) on a non-customer canary quickly. If good, we can pin.

deploy-bot: Automatic action available: 
```
# quarantine tenant from canary routing
redwood routing update --tenant tenant-thor-42 --remove-route canary --add-route stable-fallback
# pin artifact for canary group
redwood deploy pin --pool dedicated-thor-nyc-canary --artifact build-2026-04-02-a9b1
```

Jonah S: Aiden, can you run the routing update now? I'll coordinate capacity checks and run smoke tests on stable.

Aiden H: running routing change now. Output: 
```
> routing change submitted: 2026-04-09T02:23:10Z
> tenant-thor-42 removed from dedicated-thor-nyc-canary
> tenant-thor-42 added to dedicated-thor-nyc-stable-fallback
```

Priya R: started quick validation against pinned artifact on a disposable canary node. Smoke: generation endpoint returns 200, kvcache allocation stable at low headroom.

deploy-bot: Pin command queued: 
```
redwood deploy pin --pool dedicated-thor-nyc-canary --artifact build-2026-04-02-a9b1
> queued by Aiden H at 2026-04-09T02:26:03Z
```

Maria C: Thor CS acknowledged change, asked for ETA on full remediation. I told them we'll confirm once stable traffic shows normal metrics (expected 10-15m).

Jonah S: capacity check: stable-fallback pool has free capacity for +8 p50 requests/s sustained, no immediate throttling. Monitoring for background queue growth.

Priya R: smoke tests passed on the pinned artifact. No OOMs reproduced on KV grow. I recommend we keep the pin and monitor for 30m, then decide if a full rollback across all canaries is necessary.

Aiden H: setting short-lived alert suppression for this tenant to avoid noisy paging while monitoring. Will re-enable after verification window.

IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Action log: tenant quarantine and canary pin executed. Incident severity: S2 (customer-impacting but contained).

Jonah S: next steps: 30m observation window, run end-to-end tests for Thor's traffic patterns, if error rate <1% and latency back to baseline mark resolved and communicate to Thor. If errors persist revert full pool to pinned artifact and prepare emergency rollback runbook.

Ken L: Lucas on sales asked for an embargoed summary for Thor execs. Maria, can you draft short note after we confirm stability?

Maria C: yup, I'll draft and share with oncall for approval.

Aiden H: handing off to night oncall @Jonah S for observation window (handoff note: routing change performed, pin applied, smoke tests green, monitoring dashboards: per-tenant errors + latency, capacity report).

Jonah S: ack, I'll own the 30m. will escalate to Priya if errors creep above 2% or memory patterns reappear.

Priya R: posting quick snippet of the failing stack for records: 
```
# excerpt
at attention_kv_put (alloc.c:412)
at runtime_forward (forward.c:77)
at model_handle_request (handler.c:221)
```

Aiden H: final note: keep pinned-artifact id in incident thread. pinned-> build-2026-04-02-a9b1. quarantined tenant: tenant-thor-42. pool: dedicated-thor-nyc-canary -> moved to stable-fallback.

IncidentBot: :hourglass: 30m observation window started at 2026-04-09T02:28:40Z. Will post follow-up when window ends.

Jonah S: (10m check) error rate dropped to 0.8% for tenant-thor-42; latency p95 improved ~120ms -> baseline. No regressions observed.

Maria C: Thor responded saying loads look normal on their side, thanks team.

Jonah S: (30m check) stable. Closing incident after postmortem. I'll open a follow-up channel for RCA and mitigation items.

IncidentBot: :lock: Incident closed by Jonah S at 2026-04-09T02:58:55Z. Tags: tenant-isolation, canary-pin, rollback-prevented.
